title: Homeless man talks openly about being addicted to heroin. We have an opioid crisis in America.
summary: A short street interview from Invisible People with Keith, a homeless man in Los Angeles who lost his housing-industry job in the crash and moved from painkillers to heroin because it was cheaper. He talks candidly about the grip of addiction.
why: HN commenters point to it in threads on homelessness and drug policy as a short, honest firsthand account from an articulate addict.

quote.text: Extremely powerful 5 minute interview with an obviously intelligent homeless person addicted to heroin: Terrifying
